flag-green.purpose: The Tricolore Rule: the top band and the flag mark only. Government specification (DPCM 14 April 2006, art. 31: Pantone textile 17-6153, 11-0601, 18-1662) in Pantone's sRGB; the same in both schemes.

flag-white.purpose: The Tricolore Rule: the top band and the flag mark only. Government specification (DPCM 14 April 2006, art. 31: Pantone textile 17-6153, 11-0601, 18-1662) in Pantone's sRGB; the same in both schemes.

flag-red.purpose: The Tricolore Rule: the top band and the flag mark only. Government specification (DPCM 14 April 2006, art. 31: Pantone textile 17-6153, 11-0601, 18-1662) in Pantone's sRGB; the same in both schemes.

flag-edge.purpose: The hairline (line) along the flag's white band on white paper; none on the dark page.

display.purpose: The page title before a plan; the day heading from 640px.

headline.purpose: Day heading on phones; page message titles.

title.purpose: Place names on the board; the trip's dates as the plan view's heading; sheet titles.

tab.purpose: Day tab names and highlight place names.

time.purpose: Start times in the board time column, tabular.

body-sm.purpose: Facts, hints, the reason line, the source line, fact values; the subtitle, led by the meal role in ink at 500.

label.purpose: Field labels, the highlights heading, fact terms (muted), photo chips, the count badge, map stop numbers. Never uppercase.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: The toast, the swap side sheet and the centred sheet panel from 768px.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets on phones, cast upward.

shadows.name: shadow-popup
shadows.purpose: A map stop's popup and the full-screen map's day switcher: the two things that float over the map.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Backdrop behind an open sheet; blurred behind Edit trip and More options.

shadows.name: sheet-blur
shadows.purpose: Backdrop blur behind every sheet (Edit trip, More options, a stop's or a place's details, About this data); a second sheet only dims.

shadows.name: recede-page
shadows.purpose: Scale of the page behind a phone sheet.

shadows.name: recede-sheet
shadows.purpose: Scale of a sheet with another sheet over it.

shadows.name: recede-surround
shadows.purpose: What shows around the page while it scales back on phones, as on iOS.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Things arriving: presses, menus, chevrons, draws.

motion.name: ease-content
motion.purpose: Content arriving: board rows, details, day panels.

motion.name: spring-snappy
motion.purpose: Indicators and thumbs: the day-tab bar, the pace thumb, the count badge, the toast. At most 0.6% overshoot.

motion.name: spring-smooth
motion.purpose: Sheets, and the page and sheet receding behind them. No overshoot.

motion.name: dur-move
motion.purpose: Small moves: chevrons, details, day change.

motion.name: dur-arrive
motion.purpose: Option fields in the More options sheet (cap 6, after 80ms) and swap sheet alternatives (cap 8).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Replaces every arrival; springs and presses stop.

motion.name: tricolore-draw
motion.value: 900ms ease-out after 60ms; flag bands 420ms, 70ms apart; wave 1600ms (SMIL, 12 even steps)
motion.purpose: The page's first moment, from the top left: the band draws in from the left, the flag mark's bands drop in, then one breath of wind ripples from the hoist to the fly (lift up to 2.4 of 20, the fly in by 1 of 30) with a fold of light and shade from the cloth's slope, and rest. Reduced motion: at rest, no draw, no wave.

motion.name: map-grow
motion.value: 450ms on spring-smooth to open, 340ms to close; reduced motion: a 180ms fade in, 160ms out
motion.purpose: The full-screen map grows out of the page map's box and shrinks back into it: the frame scales and the map inside is scaled back by the inverse at every step (24 keyframes on the Web Animations API), so the map is never stretched and the window reveals more of it. The camera glides with it. The header drops 8px and the day switcher rises 8px after 120ms; the page fades to paper behind.

motion.name: map-popup
motion.value: 250ms hover delay, 150ms grace on leave; fade 180ms and scale 0.96 to 1 over 220ms
motion.purpose: A map stop's popup, from the side of its stop. Reduced motion: the fade only.

motion.name: details-step
motion.value: day-in: 10px and opacity over 220ms on ease-content; the last photo waits 120ms, then fades out over 180ms; reduced motion: a 120ms fade
motion.purpose: A step in a stop's details: the name, subtitle, credit, facts, caveats and listing slide in from the side the stop came from (--from), while the sheet, its controls and the photo's frame stay. The next photo fades in over the last. A swipe follows the finger (a quarter of the way past the ends) and springs back on ease-out over 220ms when it falls short.

sheet.radius: 20px (--sheet-radius): top corners on phones, all four from 768px
sheet.top: 12px (--sheet-top): gap under the status bar for a tall sheet
sheet.stack: 24px (--sheet-stack): a sheet over another starts this much lower
sheet.aboutPanelWidth: min(760px, 100% - 48px) from 768px: About this data, whose body scrolls on its own
sheet.kinds: Edit trip and About this data are tall (to 12px under the status bar on phones); More options, Change city, a place's details and a stop's details on a day of one stop fit their content
sheet.steps: Previous and Next in a stop's details: 44px outline pills of one width in a foot bar (hairline above, surface, 10px padding plus the home indicator's inset) on phones; 44px quiet round pills with a hairline before Close from 768px; the position ('3 of 6') in the muted label role between them, 4.5em wide
sheet.detailsHeight: a stop's details on a day of several stops: from under the status bar (12px) on phones, min(100dvh - 64px, 880px) from 768px, so a step never resizes it
sheet.swipe: the first 10px decide the axis; across follows the finger and steps past 64px or on a flick (0.35px/ms past 24px); down scrolls the body, or closes from the head
sheet.city: Change city: the day's own city first under an ink rule, marked 'This day' after a 16px gold check, with 'New ideas for this day' (a 44px outline pill with a circling arrow); every other city a full-width row button between hairlines (12px 10px padding, the name in the tab role at 1.0625rem, one muted 0.875rem line saying how the day meets the days either side, then its places); a city the day can take has the city pill's 16px onward chevron after its name, muted, ink on hover and focus, nudging 2px on a pointer; a city not allowed keeps its row with no chevron, name muted, its reason as the line and its description, aria-disabled, and a reason the same for every city is in full on its first row and short after it. Rows drop in 28ms apart after 80ms, cap 6

map.stop: 28px ink disc (paper ring, dashed for an approximate place) in a 44px round button named 'Stop 2, Borghese Gallery, 10:50 to 12:50, lunch'; lifts to 1.08 on hover and while its popup shows; the focus ring follows the disc
map.popup: square, 1px line, surface, --shadow-popup; 176 to 248px wide; 22px from the stop's centre, above, below, right or left, centred or lined up with the stop's number, wherever it stays 8px inside the map (clear of Expand map, the notch and the day switcher) and covers the fewest other stops, then the least route; never covers its own stop. Number on a 22px disc, place name in the tab role, times in the time role, the role (meal in ink 500, visit muted), 'Details' as a text button
map.expand: 44px outline round pill, 8px in from the top right; the camera frames the day with 82px of top padding when a stop would otherwise reach it
map.fullscreen: native dialog (showModal) at 100dvh: paper header with a hairline (title role day, muted stop count, Close map: round on phones, words from 640px), clearing the status bar and notch; the day switcher (segmented pill track, ink thumb, --shadow-popup) 16px above the home indicator; credits in full from 1024px
map.instances: one MapLibre map, moved between the page and the dialog: first full-screen frame in 30 to 45ms; a second map measured 250 to 630ms to its first frame, 490 to 710ms to idle with a warm cache, and 9.6MB (38MB at 2x) more drawing buffers

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: "Plan my trip": the page's one ink pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); display:inline-flex; width:100%; min-height:52px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--fill,#11110f); color:var(--fill-fg,#fff); font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-0.01em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease, transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--fill-hover,#2a2a26); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#7d5f2c); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Pill
components.description: Outline pill: Edit trip and Copy link in the trip header, icon and words at every width (two equal pills in one row on phones). Dimmed to 40% and inert (aria-disabled, still focusable) while a plan is on its way.
components.css: .ds-pill-line { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; padding:0 16px 0 14px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#85837a); border-radius:999px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--fg,#11110f); font-size:0.9375rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill-line:hover { border-color:var(--fg,#11110f); background:var(--hover,#f3f3f0); } .ds-pill-line:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-pill-line[aria-disabled="true"] { opacity:0.4; pointer-events:none; } .ds-pill-line:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#7d5f2c); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Source Line
components.description: One line of fact under the trip's dates, not a control: how the plan was made and, for a plan made without the AI, why in a few words, led by a check that draws itself (gold ring and gold-text tick for the AI planner, ink for the rules) on the claim's first line. A plan that breaks a rule gets the red dot and the count to fix in danger. Body small, 0.875rem at 1.35, in a compact row: the claim's first line with 4px of air above and below, close under the dates and pace. The 44px Undo pill at the line's end is centred on that first line and hangs over the air, so the header keeps its height when Undo comes and goes. About this data explains the words.
components.html:
Planned with AI

Planned without AI: the AI planner timed out

Planned with AI, edited, 1 problem to fix
components.css: .ds-source { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); max-width:358px; color:var(--fg,#11110f); } .ds-source-row { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; } .ds-source-line { display:flex; min-width:0; flex:1; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; margin:0; padding:4px 0; font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-mark { width:20px; height:20px; flex-shrink:0; margin-top:calc((1.35em - 20px) / 2); fill:none; stroke:var(--fg,#11110f); stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-mark circle, .ds-mark path { stroke-dasharray:1; } .ds-mark circle { stroke-width:1.4; animation:ds-draw 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 120ms both; } .ds-mark path { stroke-width:1.8; animation:ds-draw 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 420ms both; } .ds-mark--ai circle { stroke:var(--gold,#a8864b); } .ds-mark--ai path { stroke:var(--accent,#7d5f2c); } .ds-dot { width:10px; height:10px; flex-shrink:0; margin:calc((1.35em - 10px) / 2) 5px 0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--danger,#b3261e); } .ds-danger { color:var(--danger,#b3261e); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-undo { min-height:44px; margin:calc((0.875rem * 1.35 + 8px - 44px) / 2) 0; padding:0 14px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:none; color:var(--muted,#6a6a63); font:inherit; font-size:0.9375rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-undo:hover { color:var(--fg,#11110f); background:var(--hover,#f3f3f0); } @keyframes ds-draw { from { stroke-dashoffset:1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mark circle, .ds-mark path { animation:none; } }

components.name: Pace Control
components.description: Segmented pill track with one ink thumb on a spring.
components.css: .ds-seg { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); padding:3px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#85837a); border-radius:999px; background:var(--surface,#fff); isolation:isolate; max-width:360px; } .ds-seg::before { content:""; position:absolute; top:3px; bottom:3px; left:3px; width:calc((100% - 6px)/3); z-index:-1; border-radius:999px; background:var(--fill,#11110f); transform:translateX(100%); transition:transform 450ms linear(0,0.096 6.3%,0.511 19.5%,0.814 32.8%,0.938 43.8%,0.997 58.8%,1.006 72.3%,1); } .ds-seg-o { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:999px; color:var(--fg,#11110f); font-size:0.9375rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg-o:not(.ds-on):hover { background:var(--hover,#f3f3f0); } .ds-on { color:var(--fill-fg,#fff); }

components.name: Text Input
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Start date<input class="ds-input" type="text" value="Thu 15 Oct"></label>
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); display:block; max-width:320px; color:var(--fg,#11110f); font-size:0.875rem; font-stretch:87.5%; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.02em; } .ds-input { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); display:block; width:100%; margin-top:8px; min-height:48px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#85837a); border-radius:0; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--fg,#11110f); font-size:16px; font-weight:400; font-stretch:100%; letter-spacing:0; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; transition:border-color 140ms ease; box-sizing:border-box; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--fg,#11110f); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--fg,#11110f); outline:2px solid var(--focus,#7d5f2c); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: Square interest and base chips; ink when chosen.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-chip { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); min-height:44px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#85837a); border-radius:0; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--fg,#11110f); font-size:0.9375rem; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 140ms ease, transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip:hover:not(.ds-chip-on) { border-color:var(--fg,#11110f); } .ds-chip:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#7d5f2c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-chip-on { border-color:var(--fill,#11110f); background:var(--fill,#11110f); color:var(--fill-fg,#fff); }

components.name: Note Chips
components.description: What the data cannot confirm, said on the row.
components.html: Hours estimatedApproximate locationClosed that day
components.css: .ds-notes { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; } .ds-note { display:inline-flex; min-height:26px; align-items:center; padding:0 9px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#85837a); color:var(--fg,#11110f); font-size:0.8125rem; font-weight:500; } .ds-warn { border-color:var(--warn,#f3d27a); background:var(--warn,#f3d27a); color:var(--warn-fg,#11110f); } .ds-err { border-color:var(--danger,#b3261e); color:var(--danger,#b3261e); }

components.name: Day Tabs
components.description: Equal columns, one gold indicator that springs between days.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-on">Day 1<small>Thu 15 Oct</small></button><button class="ds-tab">Day 2<small>Fri 16 Oct</small></button><button class="ds-tab">Day 3<small>Sat 17 Oct</small></button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); position:relative; display:grid; grid-auto-flow:column; grid-auto-columns:1fr; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dcdad3); } .ds-tabs::after { content:""; position:absolute; bottom:-1px; left:0; width:33.333%; height:2px; background:var(--gold,#a8864b); } .ds-tab { min-height:60px; padding:10px 6px 10px 0; border:0; background:none; color:var(--muted,#6a6a63); text-align:left; font:inherit; font-size:1rem; font-stretch:112.5%; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-0.01em; cursor:pointer; transition:color 140ms ease; } .ds-tab small { display:block; margin-top:1px; font-size:0.875rem; font-stretch:100%; font-weight:400; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab-on { color:var(--fg,#11110f); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#7d5f2c); outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Board Row
components.description: The departure board: tabular condensed times alone in their column, wide place name, the meal role in ink leading the subtitle, hairline under, split-flap arrival. The photo and Details open the stop's details sheet.
components.html:
1. 09:3011:00

    Roscioli

    Lunch, restaurant in Centro Storico

    Open early, close to the next stop.
components.css: .ds-board { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; border-top:1px solid var(--fg,#11110f); } .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:84px 1fr; column-gap:14px; padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dcdad3); } .ds-times { display:flex; flex-direction:column; margin:0; font-stretch:87.5%; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; transform-origin:50% 0; animation:ds-flap 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) both; } .ds-start { font-size:1.3125rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.15; color:var(--fg,#11110f); } .ds-end { margin-top:2px; font-size:0.9375rem; color:var(--muted,#6a6a63); } .ds-body { animation:ds-rise 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 40ms both; } .ds-name { margin:0; color:var(--fg,#11110f); font-size:1.25rem; font-stretch:125%; font-weight:500; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-sub { margin:2px 0 0; color:var(--muted,#6a6a63); font-size:0.875rem; } .ds-role { color:var(--fg,#11110f); font-weight:500; } .ds-reason { display:flex; gap:10px; margin:8px 0 0; color:var(--muted,#6a6a63); font-size:0.875rem; font-style:oblique 6deg; } .ds-dot { width:7px; height:7px; flex-shrink:0; margin-top:0.45em; border-radius:999px; background:var(--gold,#a8864b); } @keyframes ds-flap { 0% { opacity:0; transform:perspective(240px) rotateX(-88deg); } 60% { opacity:1; transform:perspective(240px) rotateX(6deg); } 100% { transform:perspective(240px) rotateX(0); } } @keyframes ds-rise { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(8px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-times, .ds-body { animation:ds-fade 150ms ease both; } } @keyframes ds-fade { from { opacity:0; } }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: Edit trip, More options, a stop's details, a place's details and About this data: a bottom sheet on phones with a grabber and rounded top corners, a centred 20px-rounded panel from 768px (up to 560px; About this data up to 760px), over a blurred scrim. Photos inside stay square. A stop's details steps through the day with Previous and Next without moving (Details Steps).
components.html:
More options

Interests, bases and places to include.
components.css: .ds-sheet-stage { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); position:relative; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; min-height:220px; background:var(--scrim,rgb(17 17 15 / 0.42)); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); } .ds-sheet { position:relative; width:100%; padding:18px 16px 24px; border-radius:20px 20px 0 0; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--fg,#11110f); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sheet,0 -14px 40px -8px rgb(17 17 15 / 0.22)); animation:ds-sheet-up 450ms linear(0,0.022 3%,0.086 6.5%,0.446 20.3%,0.731 34.8%,0.899 52%,0.978 77%,1) both; } .ds-grabber { position:absolute; top:6px; left:50%; width:36px; height:5px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--line-strong,#85837a); translate:-50% 0; } .ds-sheet-head { display:flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; } .ds-sheet-title { margin:0; font-size:1.25rem; font-stretch:125%; font-weight:500; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-close { display:inline-flex; width:44px; height:44px; margin-right:-10px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:none; color:var(--fg,#11110f); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease, transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-close:hover { background:var(--hover,#f3f3f0); } .ds-close:active { transform:scale(0.94); } .ds-close:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#7d5f2c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-sheet-lede { margin:4px 0 0; color:var(--muted,#6a6a63); font-size:0.9375rem; line-height:1.4; } @keyframes ds-sheet-up { from { transform:translateY(100%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sheet { animation:ds-sheet-fade 150ms ease both; } } @keyframes ds-sheet-fade { from { opacity:0; } }

components.name: Highlight Tile
components.description: One button per highlight: the square photo, the name in the tab role with a muted chevron that points onward, the city in muted. No credit line: it opens the place sheet, where the photo's full credit is. On a pointer an ink hairline draws round the photo and the photo leans in; focus rings the whole tile. Photo, name and city rows are shared across the grid (subgrid).
components.css: .ds-tiles { font-family: var(--font-sans, "TikTok Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); grid-template-rows:repeat(3, auto); grid-auto-flow:column; gap:0 8px; padding:4px; max-width:420px; } .ds-tile { display:grid; grid-row:span 3; grid-template-rows:subgrid; padding:0; border:0; background:none; color:var(--fg,#11110f); font:inherit; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tile:active { transform:scale(0.98); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#7d5f2c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-tile-photo { display:block; aspect-ratio:1; overflow:hidden; background:var(--tile,#f4f4f1); outline:1px solid transparent; outline-offset:2px; transition:outline-color 140ms ease; } .ds-tile-photo span { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; background:var(--line,#dcdad3); transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } @media (hover:hover) { .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-photo { outline-color:var(--fg,#11110f); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-photo span { transform:scale(1.04); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-chev { translate:2px 0; } } .ds-tile-name { margin-top:8px; font-size:0.9375rem; font-stretch:112.5%; font-weight:500; line-height:1.25; } .ds-chev { display:inline-block; margin-left:3px; color:var(--muted,#6a6a63); vertical-align:-1px; transform:rotate(-90deg); transition:translate 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tile-city { color:var(--muted,#6a6a63); font-size:0.8125rem; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tile, .ds-tile-photo span, .ds-chev { transition:none; } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-photo span { transform:none; } .ds-tile:hover .ds-chev { translate:none; } .ds-tile:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Place Summary

narrative.overview:
Each day is a board you check once and trust, drawn in the Goodpix language of paper and ink. The page is white, text is near-black ink, and ink is the only solid fill. Gold never fills; it draws: the chosen day, the AI mark, focus. Rows are separated by 1px hairlines rather than boxed, containers and photos are square, and anything you press is a round pill. The one rounded surface is a sheet, the owner's Apple-style exception. The flag's own colours appear in two places only, by the owner's request: a thin band across the top of the page and the flag mark that leads the first screen's title (the Tricolore Rule).

Rank lives in TikTok Sans's width axis, not in weight. The widest cut carries the page title, a wide cut carries day headings and place names, and the condensed cut carries times and labels in tabular figures, like a printed station board. Weight marks state and emphasis. Checked facts stand upright; the one line of commentary per stop leans on the slant axis.

Motion starts at the top left: the flag's band draws across the top of the page as it opens, the flag mark's bands drop in and one breath of wind passes through it, and the rail diagram draws from Milan down to Rome. Then the split-flap arrival. When a plan lands, each row's times drop from a top hinge into place while the rest of the row rises in, in a sweep from the top left to the bottom right. After an edit, only the times that moved flip, and the touched row glows gold and fades. Sheets rise on a smooth spring over a dimmed, softly blurred page, and on a phone the page behind scales back as on iOS. The day's map grows out of its frame to fill the screen on the same spring, a window opening onto a map that is never stretched, and shrinks back into its frame on the way out. Stepping to the next stop in a stop's details slides the new stop in from its side, like a new day's board, while the sheet and the photo's frame hold still. Every animation moves only transform and opacity, and reduced motion swaps each of them for a short crossfade or nothing. The whole world has a real dark mode, where ink and paper trade places and gold lightens.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and ink, with ink as the one solid fill.
Gold draws and marks; it does not fill (one exception, the count badge).
The flag's colours on the top band and the flag mark only.
Hairlines between rows; boxes are rare.
Square containers, inputs and photos; round pills for anything pressed; rounded corners on sheets only.
No navbar in the plan view: the trip's dates are the page heading.
Split-flap arrival in a top-left to bottom-right sweep.
Light and dark, both checked to WCAG AA for every text pair.

rules.name: The One Fill Rule
rules.body: Ink is the only solid fill on the page. Primary actions, chosen states and markers take ink; nothing else is filled except the caution chip and the count badge. Small marks (dots, the caution square, the sheet grabber) are marks, not fills.

rules.name: The Gold Draws Rule
rules.body: Gold is a line, a dot, a bar, an underline or a focus ring. The count badge (gold paper under ink) is the one place gold fills.

rules.name: The Danger Never Fills Rule
rules.body: An error is danger text, a danger hairline and a danger dot. It never takes a red background, and colour is never the only sign: a chip says what is wrong.

rules.name: The Tricolore Rule
rules.body: The flag's colours appear in two places and nowhere else, by the owner's request: the band across the top of the page (4px, green, white and red in equal thirds, under the status bar, on the first screen and the plan alike) and the flag mark that leads the first screen's title (the flag's 2:3 at the title's cap height, square). They are never UI colours: no green for success, and errors keep their own danger red; gold remains the accent everywhere else. The band draws in once from the left and the mark's bands drop in, before one breath of wind ripples through it and it rests flat. The wind lays paper and ink over the colours at low opacity, lit where the cloth turns up toward the top left and shaded where it falls away, and at nothing once the flag is flat; never a flag colour anywhere else. Reduced motion shows both at rest, with no draw and no wave. Both are decoration, hidden from assistive technology.

rules.name: The Width Is Rank Rule
rules.body: Change width to change importance. Use 150, 125, 112.5 and 87.5, and leave weight for state.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Only Rule
rules.body: Times, dates, durations and counts get tabular figures; prose does not, because the feature widens commas and periods in this font.

rules.name: The Commentary Leans Rule
rules.body: Checked facts stand upright. The one line of commentary per stop is set at a 6deg oblique, and so is a place's AI summary in its sheet: words the AI wrote lean, under a label that says so; the listing's own words stand upright beside their hairline.

rules.name: The Only Floating Things Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: A row, a card, an input or a photo never has a shadow. If it does not float over the page, it is flat.

rules.name: The Rounded Sheet Rule
rules.body: The sheets (Edit trip, More options, a stop's details, a place's details, Change city and About this data) are the one rounded surface, at 20px, by the owner's explicit request for Apple-style sheets. The top corners round where a bottom sheet meets the screen edge; a centred panel rounds all four. Fields, containers and photos inside a sheet stay square, and nothing on the page rounds.

rules.name: The Unstretched Map Rule
rules.body: The map is never scaled out of its proportions to animate it. Motion moves a window onto it, or its camera; its discs stay round and its labels stay upright at every frame.

rules.name: The Steady Sheet Rule
rules.body: Moving within a sheet never moves the sheet or its controls. Stepping between stops keeps the sheet's height and place, the head and the foot bar where they are, and the photo's frame where it is: the new photo fades in over the last, which waits 120ms and then fades out whether the new one has come or not, so no place ever wears another's photo on a slow connection. Only the words and the credit slide, 10px from the side the stop came from, over 220ms (the day panels' day-in); reduced motion fades them over 120ms and nothing follows the finger.

rules.name: The Rest Stays Put Rule
rules.body: Planning one day never moves another day's places, and never blocks the rest of the page. Only the day being planned turns to a skeleton; its neighbours, the tabs, the header and the sheet's other cities stay where they were, and a city the day cannot take is shown in place with the reason, never hidden.

dos: **Do** use ink as the only solid fill, and gold only as a line, dot, bar, underline or focus ring.
**Do** separate rows with 1px hairlines instead of boxing them.
**Do** keep containers, inputs, chips and photos square and make anything pressed a 999px pill; round only a sheet, at 20px.
**Do** rank type by width (150, 125, 112.5, 87.5) and keep weight for state.
**Do** set every time, date and count in tabular figures, and prose without them.
**Do** move only transform and opacity, use the motion tokens, and give every animation a reduced-motion crossfade or none.
**Do** define every new colour as a semantic custom property with a checked dark value.
**Do** keep every control at least 44px tall and every text input at 16px.
**Do** open the plan view with the trip header, not a navbar.
**Do** keep the flag's colours to the top band and the flag mark, at the government's values.
**Do** open a stop's details from the map and the board into the same sheet, and give focus back to what opened it, or to the same kind of control for the stop the traveler stepped to.
**Do** keep a sheet, its controls and its photo's frame still while its content changes; move only the content.
**Do** keep the rest of the trip in use while one day is planned again, and say under that day how it was planned.
donts: **Don't** fill with gold anywhere except the count badge.
**Don't** give a row, card, input or photo a shadow; only floating things cast one.
**Don't** round containers or photos (sheets are the one exception), and don't put a hero photo over a stack of rounded stop cards.
**Don't** fill errors with red or rely on colour alone to say something is wrong.
**Don't** uppercase labels, and don't put a label above a heading; a stop's meal role starts the line under its name.
**Don't** present a city or topic photo full bleed as if it were the place.
**Don't** show more than two thumbnails in a day's board.
**Don't** use the flag's green or red as a UI colour, or put the flag anywhere but the top band and the flag mark.
**Don't** open a stop's details inside its row; they open in the sheet.
**Don't** put a credit line under a small photo; the full credit belongs where the photo is large, one tap away.
**Don't** show AI-written words without their label, upright, or as the listing's.
**Don't** hide a Previous or Next that has nowhere to go; dim it in place.
**Don't** put how a plan was made behind a tap or a disclosure; the source line says it in one line of fact, and About this data explains the words.
**Don't** stretch the map to animate it, or put a control where a stop can sit under it.
**Don't** hide a city a day cannot move to; show it dimmed in place with the planner's reason.
